note: Lean carries the strong convergence of the time-axis OS semigroup to the ground projection in OS.Semigroup.emerges and uses it in Ground.receives for the compression limits. It argues without spectral resolution: the identity with the integral of e^{-2t lambda} is replaced by a norm-monotonicity Cauchy argument.

snippet.text:
theorem emerges (x : H) : Tendsto (fun t => S.E t x) atTop (𝓝 (S.orth x)) := by
  let f t := S.E t x
  have he : Antitone (fun t => ‖f t‖^2) := fun _ _ h => sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    |>.mpr (S.norm_decrease x h)
  let c := ⨅ t, ‖f t‖^2
  have hb : BddBelow (range fun t => ‖f t‖^2) := ⟨0,by rintro z ⟨y,rfl⟩; exact sq_nonneg _⟩
  have hl : Tendsto (fun t => ‖f t‖^2) atTop (𝓝 c) := tendsto_atTop_ciInf he hb
  have hi (u v) : inner ℂ (f u) (f v) = inner ℂ x (f (u+v)) := by unfold f; rw [S.swing,S.time]; rfl
  have hh (u v) (h : u ≤ v) : dist (f u) (f v) ^ 2 ≤ ‖f u‖^2 - ‖f v‖^2 := by
    let t := (u+v)/2
    have ht : t≤v := by unfold t; rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; rw [mul_two]; gcongr
    have hw : t+t=u+v := by simp [t]
    rw [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ),hi u v,← hw, ← hi,inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    linarith [he ht]
  have ht : CauchySeq f := by
    apply Metric.cauchySeq_iff'.mpr
    intro ε hp
    obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := (hl.eventually (gt_mem_nhds
      (show c<c+ε^2 from lt_add_of_pos_right _ (pow_pos hp 2)))).exists
    refine ⟨N,fun i h => ?_⟩
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ dist_nonneg hp.le).mp
    have hn := hh N i h; rw [dist_comm] at hn
    have hy : c≤‖f i‖^2 := ciInf_le hb i

proof_context.conclusion: S.E t x tends to S.orth x as t -> infinity: the OS semigroup converges strongly to the projection onto its fixed space, proved by monotonicity of norms and a Cauchy argument without spectral theory.

lemma receives (H : Steady V) (v : ℕ → V.H) (x : V.H) (h : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 x)) (u : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hu : Tendsto u atTop atTop)
    (s : ℕ → Cross timeAxis) : Tendsto (fun i => V.flow.U (s i) (V.flow.E (u i) (v i))) atTop (𝓝 (V.flow.orth x)) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr; intro ε he
  have hh := (V.flow.emerges x).comp hu
  filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp h (ε/2) (by positivity),Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hh (ε/2) (by positivity)] with i hi hp
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle _ (V.flow.U (s i) (V.flow.E (u i) x)) _)
  have hx : V.flow.U (s i) (V.flow.orth x)=V.flow.orth x := H (V.D.orthogonalProjectionOnto x) _
  suffices he : dist (V.flow.E (u i) (v i)) (V.flow.E (u i) x) ≤ dist (v i) x by
    simp_rw [dist_eq_norm] at *
    conv => enter [1,2]; rw [← hx]
    rw [← map_sub,V.flow.unitary,← map_sub (V.flow.U (s i)),V.flow.unitary]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hp;linarith
  rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub (V.flow.E _),dist_eq_norm]
  exact ((V.flow.E (u i)).le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (V.flow.shrinks _))

proof_context.conclusion: Using emerges, translated and time-evolved vectors converge to the projection, the strong limit inserted in the multi-cluster train/compression construction.
